source.name: Manchester United – Snapdragon club partner page
source.quote: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. is the official principal shirt partner for Manchester United’s men’s, women’s and academy teams, featuring the Snapdragon brand.
source.note: date precision: page current in 2026; replaces the Microsoft Surface announcement as the front-placement source, which was about the back-of-shirt deal.

source.name: Manchester United – 'SumUp becomes United's Official Sleeve Partner'
source.quote: will see the SumUp logo feature on the sleeve of the playing shirt for the men’s, women’s and Academy teams across all competitions

source.name: Manchester United, Microsoft Surface to feature on United shirts
source.quote: The brand will additionally feature on the back of United Women’s matches across the campaign and selective Academy team kits.

source.name: Manchester United – 'Betway announced as Official Principal Partner'
source.quote: Through the new agreement, the Betway logo will feature on the training kits of Manchester United’s men’s and women’s teams.

summary: Snapdragon fronts the Manchester United Women shirt, with SumUp on the sleeve, Microsoft Surface on the back and Betway on the training kit for 2026/27. Placements checked 2026-10-03 against the club's own sponsor announcements (front, sleeve, back, training kit each name the women's teams) and against the official United Store product photos for product 5775 (Womens 26/27 Home Authentic Jersey), which show no sponsor marks on the chest besides Snapdragon, no shorts sponsor and no other sleeve or patch branding.
